user.title: Connect to Bright
user.description: Enter the credentials used by the Bright app.

site.title: Choose smart meter
site.description: Select the Bright virtual entity to use.

error.no_sites: No Bright smart-meter sites were returned for this account.

init.title: History maintenance
init.description: Repair Bright history without deleting existing ledger data or statistics.

fetch_history.title: Fetch history by date
fetch_history.description: Re-fetch the selected settled UK billing days from Bright and replay Home Assistant statistics from the first affected day.

refresh_all.description: Re-fetch all retrievable Bright history and replay the resulting Home Assistant statistics. Existing raw history is updated in place; nothing is deleted. Submit to continue.

error.refresh_failed: The Bright history refresh failed. Check the Home Assistant log for details and try again.
